title.en: One counter orders five settings it was never fitted to, and sizes none of them
title.zh: 一个计数器给五种它从未拟合过的场景排了序，却一个都没算准大小

sub.en: Read as mem_busy on one card; checked against an H200, a B300, a PRO 6000 and a second H100, and against a prediction committed before the run
sub.zh: 在一张卡上读作 mem_busy；拿 H200、B300、PRO 6000 和第二张 H100 检验，并对照一份在跑数据之前就写下的预测

blurb.en: The memory controller's busy fraction, read on one card as mem_busy, orders what a second card, a faster card or faster memory is worth across five settings it was never fitted to. Four of the five share an H100 baseline, and the one prediction committed before the data got the ordering right at both ends and the spread wrong by half.
blurb.zh: 在一张卡上读出的内存控制器忙碌比例（mem_busy），能给第二张卡、更快的卡、更快的显存各值多少排序，五种它从未拟合过的场景都排对了。其中四种共用同一条 H100 基线；唯一一份在数据之前写下的预测，两端的次序都对，跨度却少算了一半。

establishes.en: what a second card or a faster card is worth is ordered by the memory controller's busy fraction, not by the interconnect, and the ordering carries to hardware it was never fitted to
establishes.zh: 第二张卡或更快的卡值多少，排序由内存控制器的忙碌比例决定而不是互联，而且这个排序能搬到从未拟合过的硬件上

title.en: The second card buys 1.1× at decode and 1.9× at prefill
title.zh: 第二张卡在解码上只买到 1.1×，在 prefill 上买到 1.9×

sub.en: One 7900 XT, two of them, one A100 and one L4, on the same ladder
sub.zh: 一张 7900 XT、两张、一张 A100、一张 L4，同一套阶梯

blurb.en: One 7900 XT, two of them, one A100 and one L4 on the same ladder. The second consumer card is worth 1.11x to 1.23x at batch-1 decode and 1.56x to 1.87x of prefill wall time, and the L4 is slower than a consumer card on prefill's linear term.
blurb.zh: 一张 7900 XT、两张、一张 A100、一张 L4 跑同一套阶梯。第二张消费级卡在 batch-1 解码上值 1.11×–1.23×，在 prefill 墙钟时间上值 1.56×–1.87×；而 L4 在 prefill 的线性项上比消费级卡还慢。

establishes.en: the 2D attention path launches one workgroup per KV head, and tensor parallelism halves them
establishes.zh: 2D 注意力路径每个 KV head 起一个 workgroup，张量并行把它们减半

title.en: Three of eight findings are RDNA3's, and measuring another vendor removed two
title.zh: 八个结论里只有三个是 RDNA3 的，而测另一个厂商拿掉了两个

sub.en: How much of this is RDNA3 being second-class
sub.zh: 这里面有多少真的是 RDNA3 二等公民

blurb.en: This repository's own summary says RDNA3 is a second-class citizen in ROCm's kernel ecosystem. Sorting eight findings by what the evidence supports, three of them are that, and the measurements that mattered most took findings off the list.
blurb.zh: 仓库自己的总结说 RDNA3 是 ROCm kernel 生态里的二等公民。把八个结论按证据支持的范围排一排，其中三个是；而最关键的几次测量都是把结论从表上拿掉的。

establishes.en: the useful unit is the single finding, not the architecture: each of the eight has its own scope and its own evidence
establishes.zh: 有用的单位是单个结论，不是整个架构：八个里每一个都有自己的适用范围和自己的证据

title.en: The reporter's own script counts rank 0, shown by injecting a one-sided fault
title.zh: 上报者自己的脚本只数 rank 0，用一个单边故障演示出来

sub.en: How to report a bug you cannot reproduce
sub.zh: 怎么报告一个你复现不出来的 bug

blurb.en: A clean run is the least useful sentence on a bug tracker. Three things make it worth something, and the third found that the reporter's own script counts failures on rank 0 only — demonstrated by injecting a one-sided fault rather than argued.
blurb.zh: 一次干净的运行是 bug tracker 上最没用的一句话。有三件事能让它值点钱，而第三件找出了上报者自己的脚本只数 rank 0 的失败—— 是注入一个单边故障演示出来的，不是论证出来的。

establishes.en: a clean run says something only once you have shown what the instrument is blind to
establishes.zh: 一次干净的运行，只有在你说清了仪器看不见什么之后才说明问题

title.en: The excluded kernel wins all sixty cells, and the two bands overlap
title.zh: 被排除的 kernel 在六十个格子里全赢，而两个区间还互相重叠

sub.en: A gate that costs 2 to 7 times and buys nothing
sub.zh: 一道 2 到 7 倍的门，什么也没换来

blurb.en: The bound that keeps vLLM's ROCm custom paged attention off gfx11 below gqa_ratio 3 is a performance heuristic, and it is inverted here: sixty cells, two vLLM versions, and the excluded band overlaps the admitted one on both.
blurb.zh: 把 vLLM 的 ROCm 定制 paged attention 在 gfx11 上挡在 gqa_ratio 3 之外的那道界是一个性能启发式，而它在这里是反的：六十个格子、两个 vLLM 版本，被排除的区间在两边都与被放行的区间重叠。

establishes.en: the gfx11 branch requires gqa_ratio >= 3; the CDNA branch of the same function requires >= 1
establishes.zh: gfx11 分支要求 gqa_ratio >= 3，同一函数的 CDNA 分支只要求 >= 1

title.en: A flat 60 ms per step, under a cost that grows with context
title.zh: 每步固定 60 ms，压在一笔随上下文增长的开销下面

sub.en: Twelve tokens a second was two problems

blurb.en: The same model family packaged two ways differs by 3.24x at 1K of context and 1.27x at 32K. Read as milliseconds rather than as a ratio, that is one flat cost under one growing cost, and each has its own upstream fix.
blurb.zh: 同一个模型家族的两种打包，在1K 上差 3.24×，在32K 上差 1.27×。把它当毫秒而不是倍数来读，就是一笔固定开销压在一笔增长开销下面，而两者各自有自己的上游修复。

establishes.en: an asymmetric int4 checkpoint misses the native gfx1100 W4A16 kernel on a type gate
establishes.zh: 非对称 int4 checkpoint 在类型判断上错过了 gfx1100 的原生 W4A16 kernel

title.en: Two harnesses agree to 0.44 %, and the first of four runs read 31 % low
title.zh: 两套 harness 吻合到 0.44 %，而四次运行里的第一次低了 31 %

sub.en: How to measure decode on a machine like this
sub.zh: 在这样一台机器上怎么测 decode

blurb.en: The two harnesses agree to 0.44%, and finding that out took four identical runs the first of which read 31% low. What every point carries, where the chart-grade line sits, and one cell where the range and the standard deviation disagree about the direction.
blurb.zh: 两套 harness 吻合到 0.44%，而弄清这一点用了四次相同的运行，其中第一次低了 31%。每个点带什么、制图级的线划在哪里，以及有一格里极差和标准差对方向的判断相反。

establishes.en: a decode number needs a run count and a range beside it, because this machine's first run is not its steady state
establishes.zh: 一个解码数字旁边得写上运行次数和极差，因为这台机器的第一次运行不是稳态

title.en: Speculation's second query row costs 120 of 128 workgroups
title.zh: 投机的第二行 query，要付掉 128 个 workgroup 里的 120 个

sub.en: One boolean costs 71 % on a Radeon and 61 % on an A100
sub.zh: 一个布尔值，在 Radeon 上是 71 %，在 A100 上是 61 %

blurb.en: vLLM's own documented MTP assistant makes gemma-4-31B 36.9% faster at 1K of context and 70.8% slower at 32K. One clause in an or chain reads speculation's second query row as "not decode" and gives up 120 of 128 workgroups.
blurb.zh: vLLM 自己文档里的 MTP 助手让 gemma-4-31B 在 1K 上快 36.9%，在 32K 上慢 70.8%。一串 or 里的一个子句把投机的第二行 query 读成了“不是 decode”，于是交出了 128 个 workgroup 里的 120 个。

establishes.en: max_seqlen_q > 1 drops the Triton attention kernel from 128 workgroups to 8
establishes.zh: max_seqlen_q > 1 把 Triton 注意力 kernel 从 128 个 workgroup 降到 8 个

title.en: A read-only copy asks for write access, and one kernel charged a second for it
title.zh: 只读的拷贝去申请写权限，而某个内核为此每次多收一秒

sub.en: Loading weights was slower than the disk, twice over
sub.zh: 加载权重比磁盘还慢，而且慢了两次

blurb.en: A host-to-device copy only reads its source, but KFD asks for write access because the mapping is writable, and that breaks copy-on-write on every resident page. On one distro kernel each occurrence also cost a full second.
blurb.zh: host→device 的拷贝只读源数据，但 KFD 因为映射可写就去申请写权限，于是每一个驻留页的 copy-on-write 都被破坏。在某个发行版内核上，每触发一次还要多花整整一秒。

establishes.en: KFD reads the access mode off the VMA, so a read-only copy asks for write and breaks copy-on-write
establishes.zh: KFD 从 VMA 读访问模式，于是只读的拷贝也要写权限，破坏了 copy-on-write

title.en: No PCIe atomics, no hostcall buffer, and every collective fails at dispatch
title.zh: 没有 PCIe atomics 就没有 hostcall buffer，每一次集合通信都在 dispatch 处失败

sub.en: The RCCL crash was never about RCCL
sub.zh: RCCL 崩溃从来不是 RCCL 的问题

blurb.en: Two Radeons, tensor parallelism, and hipErrorIllegalState. The cause is four layers below RCCL, thirty lines of HIP reproduce it without RCCL at all, and for a virtual machine the fix is one line of configuration.
blurb.zh: 两张 Radeon、张量并行，以及 hipErrorIllegalState。根因在 RCCL 下面四层，三十行 HIP 不用 RCCL 就能复现，而对一台虚拟机来说修复是一行配置。

establishes.en: no PCIe AtomicOps means no hostcall buffer, and the dispatch is refused
establishes.zh: 没有 PCIe AtomicOps 就没有 hostcall buffer，dispatch 被拒

title.en: Eager mode recorded 107.8 tok/s as 15, and invented two findings on the way
title.zh: eager 模式把 107.8 tok/s 记成 15，顺手还造出两个结论

sub.en: The fastest model here was written off at 15 tok/s
sub.zh: 全机最快的模型曾被 15 tok/s 判死刑

blurb.en: torch.compile was given twenty minutes and needed twenty-six, so the run was forced into eager mode and a 128-expert MoE was recorded at 15 tok/s. Compiled it is 107.8, and the flag had invented two qualitative findings on the way.
blurb.zh: torch.compile 只给了二十分钟，而它需要二十六，于是这次运行被压进 eager 模式，一个 128 专家的 MoE 被记作 15 tok/s。编译之后是 107.8，而这个开关路上还凭空造出了两个定性结论。

establishes.en: vLLM assigns TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1 on import, so an export cannot override it
establishes.zh: vLLM 在 import 时就赋值 TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1，export 覆盖不掉

title.en: One kernel accounts for the whole 12.1 to 4.2 tok/s fall
title.zh: 一个 kernel 就解释了 12.1 到 4.2 tok/s 的全部下滑

sub.en: A hybrid-SSM model that decodes slower the longer you talk to it
sub.zh: 一个上下文越长解码越慢的混合 SSM 模型

blurb.en: Qwen3.6-27B falls from 12.1 to 4.2 tok/s between 500 and 32000 tokens. One kernel accounts for all of it, the custom kernel is unreachable three conditions over, and llama.cpp on the same machine rules out the driver.
blurb.zh: Qwen3.6-27B 在 500 到 32000 token 之间从 12.1 掉到 4.2 tok/s。一个 kernel 就解释了全部，定制 kernel 差三个条件都进不去，而同一台机器上的 llama.cpp 排除了驱动。

establishes.en: the few full-attention layers fall off the ROCm paged-attention fast path
establishes.zh: 少数几层全注意力掉出了 ROCm paged-attention 的快路径
